landmarks.name: Mercedes-Benz Stadium
landmarks.blurb: The pinwheel-roof stadium. Football on Sundays, soccer on Saturdays, cheap hot dogs always.

landmarks.name: State Farm Arena
landmarks.blurb: Hoops and headline concerts under one roof.

landmarks.name: Georgia Aquarium
landmarks.blurb: Whale sharks gliding overhead in one of the biggest tanks on earth.

landmarks.name: Centennial Olympic Park
landmarks.blurb: Fountains, lawns and the skyline, a legacy of the 1996 Games.

landmarks.name: Piedmont Park
landmarks.blurb: Midtown's back yard: lake, dog park and festival lawns.

landmarks.name: BeltLine Eastside Trail
landmarks.blurb: An old rail corridor turned into the city's favourite walk, lined with murals and patios.

landmarks.name: Ponce City Market
landmarks.blurb: A giant brick warehouse reborn as a food hall with a rooftop midway.

landmarks.name: Krog Street Market
landmarks.blurb: Neighbourhood food stalls next to the famous graffiti tunnel.

landmarks.name: Fox Theatre
landmarks.blurb: A 1929 movie palace with a starlit ceiling and touring Broadway shows.

landmarks.name: High Museum of Art
landmarks.blurb: Bright white galleries and the best art collection in the Southeast.

landmarks.name: Georgia Tech
landmarks.blurb: Engineers, hackathons and a very loud steam whistle.

landmarks.name: Georgia State University
landmarks.blurb: A campus woven straight into the downtown streets.

landmarks.name: Atlanta Tech Village
landmarks.blurb: A startup hub where the coffee is free and everyone is fundraising.

landmarks.name: Lenox Square
landmarks.blurb: Buckhead's flagship mall. Bring a budget.

landmarks.name: Georgia State Capitol
landmarks.blurb: The gold dome. City and state politics happen in its shadow.

landmarks.name: MLK Jr. National Historical Park
landmarks.blurb: Dr. King's birth home, church and resting place on Auburn Avenue.

landmarks.name: Little Five Points
landmarks.blurb: Record shops, vintage racks and small loud venues.

landmarks.name: Truist Park
landmarks.blurb: Baseball under the lights with a whole village built around it.

landmarks.name: Grady Memorial Hospital
landmarks.blurb: The city's safety net and trauma centre.

landmarks.name: Hartsfield-Jackson Airport
landmarks.blurb: The world's busiest airport. Fly to New York or the Bay from here.

landmarks.name: Times Square
landmarks.blurb: Walls of light, crowds at every hour, and the most expensive billboards anywhere.

landmarks.name: Central Park
landmarks.blurb: 843 acres of lawns, lakes and rocks in the middle of everything.

landmarks.name: Empire State Building
landmarks.blurb: The Art Deco icon. The view from the 86th floor is worth the queue.

landmarks.name: Grand Central Terminal
landmarks.blurb: A vaulted ceiling of constellations over half a million commuters a day.

landmarks.name: Madison Square Garden
landmarks.blurb: The world's most famous arena, sitting on top of a train station.

landmarks.name: Broadway Theater District
landmarks.blurb: Forty-one theatres and a lot of people hoping for a callback.

landmarks.name: The Met
landmarks.blurb: Five thousand years of art and the best front steps in the city.

landmarks.name: Apollo Theater
landmarks.blurb: Where stars are made and amateurs find out fast.

landmarks.name: Columbia University
landmarks.blurb: Ivy, columns and a library with its lights on all night.

landmarks.name: The High Line
landmarks.blurb: A garden on an old elevated freight line, threading between buildings.

landmarks.name: Wall Street
landmarks.blurb: The exchange, the bull and a lot of very fast walking.

landmarks.name: One World Trade Center
landmarks.blurb: The tallest tower in the country, beside the memorial pools.

landmarks.name: Brooklyn Bridge
landmarks.blurb: Stone towers and steel cables from 1883. Walk it at sunrise.

landmarks.name: DUMBO
landmarks.blurb: Cobblestones, converted warehouses and startups under the bridge.

landmarks.name: Williamsburg Music Hall
landmarks.blurb: Indie bands, rooftop bars and a line down the block.

landmarks.name: Chinatown
landmarks.blurb: Soup dumplings, roast duck in the window and the best cheap eats in town.

landmarks.name: Fifth Avenue
landmarks.blurb: Flagship stores and famous window displays.

landmarks.name: City Hall
landmarks.blurb: Where the mayor works and everyone else protests.

landmarks.name: Statue of Liberty
landmarks.blurb: Lady Liberty on her island. Take the ferry.

landmarks.name: Yankee Stadium
landmarks.blurb: Baseball in the Bronx, pinstripes and all.

landmarks.name: Coney Island
landmarks.blurb: Boardwalk, wooden coaster and hot dogs by the ocean.

landmarks.name: City General Hospital
landmarks.blurb: A hospital tower on the river.

landmarks.name: JFK Airport
landmarks.blurb: Gateway to everywhere. Fly to Atlanta or the Bay from here.

landmarks.name: Golden Gate Bridge
landmarks.blurb: International orange towers, usually wearing a scarf of fog.

landmarks.name: Ferry Building
landmarks.blurb: A clock tower over a market hall of bakers, oyster shuckers and coffee roasters.

landmarks.name: Salesforce Tower
landmarks.blurb: The tallest tower in the city, with a park on the transit centre roof next door.

landmarks.name: Pier 39
landmarks.blurb: Sea lions, sourdough bowls and street performers.

landmarks.name: Alcatraz Island
landmarks.blurb: The Rock. A cold swim from anywhere.

landmarks.name: Golden Gate Park
landmarks.blurb: Three miles of gardens, museums and bison, ending at the ocean.

landmarks.name: Dolores Park
landmarks.blurb: The sunniest hill in the city and everyone knows it.

landmarks.name: Mission Taquerias
landmarks.blurb: Foil-wrapped burritos the size of your forearm.

landmarks.name: Painted Ladies
landmarks.blurb: A row of Victorian houses with the skyline behind them.

landmarks.name: Chase Center
landmarks.blurb: Basketball on the waterfront.

landmarks.name: Oracle Park
landmarks.blurb: A ballpark where home runs land in the bay.

landmarks.name: Chinatown
landmarks.blurb: The Dragon Gate, lantern-strung alleys and dim sum.

landmarks.name: San Francisco City Hall
landmarks.blurb: A gilded dome taller than the one in Washington.

landmarks.name: The Fillmore
landmarks.blurb: Chandeliers, psychedelic posters and a free apple on the way in.

landmarks.name: UC Berkeley
landmarks.blurb: The campanile, the protests and a lot of Nobel parking spots.

landmarks.name: Lake Merritt
landmarks.blurb: Oakland's tidal lake, ringed with lights and joggers.

landmarks.name: Fox Theater Oakland
landmarks.blurb: A restored 1928 movie palace that books the best tours.

landmarks.name: Stanford University
landmarks.blurb: Sandstone arches, palm drive and a suspicious number of founders.

landmarks.name: Sand Hill Road
landmarks.blurb: Low offices, tall cheques. Bring a pitch deck.

landmarks.name: Silicon Valley Campus
landmarks.blurb: A ring-shaped headquarters with free lunch and long hours.

landmarks.name: Bay Medical Center
landmarks.blurb: A teaching hospital on a foggy hill.

landmarks.name: SFO Airport
landmarks.blurb: Runways on the bay. Fly to Atlanta or New York from here.
